title: POI Detail Visual Improvements - Material Consistency & Drag Fix
description: Fix POI detail panel drag behavior and apply material-consistent visual improvements to roster frame, stat bars, portraits, and filter controls
objectives: Fix POI detail panel drag behavior to match quest detail behavior
Apply bronze/dark border treatment to roster frame matching right panel
Transform HP/Stamina bars from smooth pills to carved/engraved stone channels
Convert portrait frames from glowing sci-fi circles to bronze/brass cameo frames
Upgrade filter controls to material/physical styling with darker backgrounds and metal studs
guardrails: Config-first design: all visual tokens from skin config modules
Skin system compliance: use existing skin registry and presets
No hardcoded values: read all colors, borders, shadows from config
I18n compliance: all user-facing strings through useTranslation
Drag system: use existing dnd-kit infrastructure, no custom drag logic
invariants: All persistence via PersistenceService (no direct localStorage)
Skin system via skinConfigRegistry (no standalone CSS files)
Safeguards: lint, test, build:check, kanban:lint before completion

deliverables.item: Fix POI detail panel drag behavior
deliverables.description: Ensure POI detail panel drags consistently like quest detail, with proper positioning and slot rack behavior
acceptanceCriteria: POI detail panel drag positioning matches quest detail behavior
Slot rack inside detail panel behaves identically to quest detail
No visual glitches or offset issues during drag operations

deliverables.description: Apply bronze/dark border treatment to roster frame matching right panel's visual language
acceptanceCriteria: Roster frame has bronze/dark border instead of transparent rounded plastic
Border uses same visual language as right panel (bronze/dark with slight chamfer)
Border radius reduced from soft smartphone rounding to slight chamfer (2-3px)
Background maintains transparency but with proper material depth

deliverables.description: Transform stat bars from smooth plastic pills to carved/engraved stone channels with strong inset shadows
acceptanceCriteria: Border radius reduced from pill shape to slight chamfer (2px or sharp corners)
Track background has strong inset shadow (box-shadow: inset 0 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.6))
Visual appearance matches carved stone channel in slate surface
HP fill appears as green linfa in carved channel
Stamina fill appears as gold powder in carved channel
Config tokens control all shadow and radius values

deliverables.description: Convert portrait frames from glowing sci-fi circles to bronze/brass cameo frames matching astrolabe pins
acceptanceCriteria: Portrait frame uses bronze/brass material instead of glowing sci-fi ring
Frame matches visual language of astrolabe pins and gold buttons
Portrait appears as cameo set in physical metal medallion
Glow effect reduced/removed to avoid sci-fi appearance
Config tokens control frame material and glow intensity

deliverables.description: Upgrade filter controls (TUTTI dropdown, sword/eye buttons) to material/physical styling
acceptanceCriteria: TUTTI dropdown has darker background and bronze border
Sword and eye filter buttons appear as metal studs/pressed buttons
Filter controls have physical depth (inset shadows, material borders)
Visual language matches other material controls in the interface
Config tokens control all filter control styling
